rationale: Authentication was initiated via email lookup and user details retrieval, and the agent acted on the user’s orders. However, several issues prevent a pass: (1) The agent executed multiple order-changing writes (returns and a pending-item modification) with no visible evidence of prior user confirmation. Policy requires confirmation before any write. (2) The address-change request to the user’s default Chicago address was not completed; the agent modified the pending item first, then attempted an address update that the system disallowed post-modification, and ultimately handed off to a human. The user’s requested address change was therefore not fulfilled. (3) The user also requested a tracking number for a cancelled order; there is no evidence the agent retrieved or explained tracking for that request. (4) There is ambiguity about correctly handling the two returns “from different orders,” since one return call included two items in the same order, though it’s unclear if that aligns with the actual order data. Given the missing confirmations, the unfulfilled address update, and lack of tracking information, the interaction did not meet the completion and policy bar.
